scope: Taiwan listed-company dividend/payout sustainability; outcome-blind append-only PIT replay contract

sourceEvidence: TWSE material-information clause 14 separates board dividend decision/change, record date, payment-date change and late payment
TWSE current disclosures expose decision/fact time, total cash dividend, per-share dividend, ex-date, record date and payment date
TWSE current disclosure for 2330 shows per-share dividend can change solely because outstanding shares changed while total cash distribution stayed constant

eventIdentity.correctionRule: Never overwrite an earlier known state. A correction/amendment is a new event linked by supersedesEventId.

payoutSemantics.invariant: Per-share dividend change is not a payout-cut signal unless total distribution and share-denominator lineage are reconciled.

sustainabilityJoin.knownAtRule: Financial-statement denominators may join only after their own first-known timestamp.
sustainabilityJoin.antiDoubleCount: One parent receipt may feed validation/context but may not create duplicate independent votes.

falsification: High yield can be caused by price decline and is not quality.
High payout can reflect maturity/weak reinvestment opportunity rather than alpha.
Stable DPS can be funded by reserves or leverage rather than current earnings/CFO.
A lower DPS after share-count change is not necessarily a lower total payout.
A dividend cut can rationally preserve liquidity and reduce distress risk.

biasFirewalls.selectionBias: Replay cohort must include maintain/increase/cut/omit states; do not sample only persistent payers.
biasFirewalls.lookAhead: Never backfill final approval, payment or corrected per-share amount into an earlier decision state.
biasFirewalls.dataSnooping: No payout/yield/coverage threshold may be chosen after return inspection.
biasFirewalls.multipleTesting: Coverage variants must be preregistered before outcome join.
biasFirewalls.factorRedundancy: Earnings/CFO/leverage primitives remain owned by D07-02/05/06.
biasFirewalls.eventClustering: Multiple dividend notices from one corporate decision chain are one linked episode, not independent alpha events.
biasFirewalls.accountingRevision: Restated financial denominators remain separate vintages.
biasFirewalls.corporateActions: Share-count changes, capital reductions/increases and stock dividends require denominator lineage.
biasFirewalls.transactionCostLiquidity: Any later strategy test must include executable liquidity/cost controls; not relevant to source-contract maturity.
biasFirewalls.regimeDependence: Any later outcome test must stratify or control cycle/regime without post-hoc best-regime selection.

required: at least one maintain/increase/cut/omit state where source history permits

exactNextContinuationPoint: Build a bounded multi-company historical append-only replay from official MOPS/TWSE records; preserve all vintages and explicit UNKNOWN; keep outcomes closed. If historical transport cannot reproduce proposal/final/payment clocks, mark SOURCE_BLOCKED or PROSPECTIVE_ONLY_FEASIBLE and continue the parallel D08-03 lane.
